newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures end higher despite U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures end higher despite U.S. data.

text.p: 1430 GMT - June bond future recovers from lows to end in the black despite strong U.S. figures and lingering doubts among analysts about the likely outcome of the May 25/June 1 election. Some traders said surprised by ability of market to resist.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.76 pct vs 5.78. Bund spread -8 vs -7
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Jun PIBOR 96.42, up 4 bp
